executive_summary: The policy is materially stronger than V2: it enforces exact canonical JSON bytes and detached hashes, rejects duplicate keys, closes nested schemas, checks target-parent-leaf relations within a supplied execution freeze, requires NTFS link_count one, derives blockers from one supplied process table, recomputes prepare evidence, compares broad prepare/publish continuity, separates read-only evidence from synthetic receipts, and never claims human identity or effect authority. It nevertheless fails the corrected implementation boundary. It never binds or validates the frozen static allowlist, accepts a wholly different 13+3 target set, lacks frozen permitted controller/current executable identities and hashes, treats an asserted hash-topology object as proof of acyclicity, and omits intra-check and cross-phase chronology ordering. The real static allowlist is also structurally incompatible with the policy: root sentinels and the receipts parent are one-component/root-relative forms rejected by _token, while five listed targets have staged bytes equal to preimage and are rejected by _freeze_files. These are reproducible implementation failures. They cannot authorize a canonical write because every result remains machine-only and explicitly blocked, but they prevent code-lock, reviewed-release, execution-freeze, or component qualification.

bounded_semantic_probes.challenge: Can a freeze whose paths and roles do not match the frozen Hosea static allowlist receive the machine-pass label?
bounded_semantic_probes.evidence: The policy test fixture uses area-1/parent/target-01.json and other synthetic roles rather than any ceb51bb9... allowlist row; validate_prepare returned the success label.

bounded_semantic_probes.challenge: Are current and permitted-controller executable file identities and hashes bound to stable freeze expectations?
bounded_semantic_probes.evidence: Changing the current normalized name to evil.exe and changing current and Codex-parent executable_identity strings to unfrozen attacker values still passed after observer consistency was updated.

bounded_semantic_probes.challenge: Does the policy calculate an acyclic dependency graph rather than trust declarative booleans?
bounded_semantic_probes.evidence: An extra zz_post_component_review dependency was accepted while component_lock_contains_post_component_review_hashes remained false. Dependencies are a required subset, not an exact typed DAG, and no edge-cycle computation exists.

bounded_semantic_probes.challenge: Must the live checker start before it ends on both clocks?
bounded_semantic_probes.evidence: Checker wall and monotonic start values were set after their end values while both remained inside capture; validation passed.

bounded_semantic_probes.challenge: Must prepare evidence chronologically precede publish evidence?
bounded_semantic_probes.evidence: A prepare capture at offsets 10-13 and a publish capture at offsets 0-3 passed publish validation because continuity omits cross-phase clock ordering.

bounded_semantic_probes.challenge: Can the policy represent the exact root sentinels and one-level receipts parent in the static allowlist?
bounded_semantic_probes.evidence: _token rejects both low_confidence_register.jsonl and receipts because it requires at least two path components; the static allowlist uses parent_token '.' for sentinels and parent_token 'receipts' for target 13.

bounded_semantic_probes.challenge: Can the exact 13-row static allowlist be frozen when some governed files are intentionally byte-identical?
bounded_semantic_probes.evidence: The policy rejects equality unconditionally. Static allowlist targets 4, 6, 9, 11, and 13 have identical preimage and staged SHA-256 values.

requirement_matrix.basis: Bytes-only input, lowercase detached SHA-256 verification, duplicate-key rejection, UTF-8 parsing, exact canonical reserialization, and closed nested schemas are enforced.
Topology is caller-authored booleans; dependency IDs are only a required subset; no explicit nodes, edges, exact-set rule, or direct/transitive cycle calculation exists.
PID/start/ancestry are correctly absent from the freeze schema and continuity-bound live, but corrected-design stable permitted executable identities and hashes are absent.
Relations are strongly checked inside the supplied freeze, but the freeze is not bound to the exact static allowlist and cannot encode its root/one-level cases.
Freeze and raw target/sentinel rows require supported link_count exactly one and continuity retains it.
Restart-after-freeze and per-capture dual-clock bounds pass review, but checker start/end ordering and prepare-before-publish ordering are missing.

Supplied inaccessible, non-running, unclassified, OneDrive, and extra bounded rows fail; exact shell-to-Codex shapes are checked. The supplied inventory may omit a writer, inventory_exhaustive is required false, and arbitrary current executable names/identities can pass.
Result always records human_identity_verified false, effect_authorized false, external capability unverified, local JSON insufficient, and canonical execution blocked.

Detached prepare raw/result hashes, exact result recomputation, and broad value continuity are enforced, but the policy cannot prove hash independence or same lease and omits cross-phase temporal ordering.
Only read_only_collector_zero_delta is accepted and synthetic transaction evidence is explicitly rejected.

The result requires final checks before one completed transition, treats post-completed drift as diagnostic unknown, and never authorizes transaction completion. Enforcement remains future wrapper/kernel work.

blocking_findings.title: The policy does not bind the exact frozen static allowlist
blocking_findings.challenge: Neither the static allowlist SHA nor its exact rows are inputs to validation, constants, or required dependencies. Any trusted freeze with 13 structurally valid targets and three sentinels can pass.
blocking_findings.counterevidence: An externally trusted execution-freeze digest would prevent later mutation of whatever rows were frozen.
blocking_findings.adjudication: Counterevidence does not close the issue because the corrected design requires the freeze rows to be allowlist-derived. Trusting a freeze digest cannot prove that its initial content matched ceb51bb9....
blocking_findings.required_resolution: Bind exact canonical static-allowlist bytes and detached ceb51bb9... hash, define a deterministic exact projection into freeze rows, require its dependency in the component lock/reviewed release, and add wrong-role, wrong-path, missing-row, extra-row, reordered-row, and wrong-source-render negatives.

blocking_findings.title: The policy cannot represent the real allowlist without reinterpretation
blocking_findings.challenge: One-component/root sentinel paths and a one-component canonical parent are forbidden, while five of the fixed 13 target rows are rejected because staged equals preimage.
blocking_findings.counterevidence: A future freeze builder could prefix root-relative paths or omit no-op replacements.
blocking_findings.adjudication: That transformation is neither specified nor hash-bound, and target count is fixed at 13. Prefixing or omission would silently alter the exact allowlist contract.
blocking_findings.required_resolution: Define an explicit non-escaping model-root parent representation and deterministic normalization. Separately choose and freeze one no-op policy: retain byte-identical governed rows as checked nonreplacement members, or remove them from the replacement set with exact changed/unchanged counts and roles.

blocking_findings.title: Acyclic topology is asserted rather than verified
blocking_findings.challenge: The component supplies topology booleans, required dependencies are a subset, and extra post-component or back-edge-like entries are accepted.
blocking_findings.counterevidence: The future external trust root and reviewed release are outside this pure policy.
blocking_findings.adjudication: External trust does not calculate or validate the corrected design's directed acyclic artifact graph.
blocking_findings.required_resolution: Use an exact typed node/edge graph, exact dependency set, predecessor-stage constraints, and deterministic direct/transitive cycle rejection. Do not allow a boolean to stand in for graph proof.

blocking_findings.title: Stable permitted executable identities and hashes are absent
blocking_findings.challenge: Raw executable_identity is arbitrary non-empty text, no executable hash exists, and no current/controller executable identity is frozen. An evil.exe current process with attacker identity strings under a Codex-named parent passed.
blocking_findings.counterevidence: PID/start/executable strings must remain identical prepare-to-publish and extra named bounded processes are blocked.
blocking_findings.adjudication: Continuity preserves an attacker-controlled identity; it does not establish that the executable is the pre-reviewed collector/controller binary required by the corrected design.
blocking_findings.required_resolution: Freeze structured permitted current/controller executable file identities and hashes, compare handle-derived live identity/hash exactly, require the current process class explicitly, and reject renamed or unlisted executable images.

blocking_findings.title: Chronology is incomplete inside the lease and across phases
blocking_findings.challenge: Individual timestamps need only fall inside capture; checker start may follow checker end. Publish capture may precede prepare capture and validation still succeeds.
blocking_findings.counterevidence: Each capture independently satisfies dual-clock age/duration bounds, and full material continuity is checked.
blocking_findings.adjudication: Freshness is not causal order. Reversed phase evidence defeats the stated prepare-then-publish protocol.
blocking_findings.required_resolution: Enforce checker start <= end on both clocks, ordered observations where required, prepare capture/validation before publish capture/validation, monotonic nondecrease, same post-restart boot, and wrapper-proven same-lease continuity.

blocking_findings.title: Process uncertainty fails only for rows the caller supplies
blocking_findings.challenge: The policy cannot detect omitted bounded writers or prove complete enumeration, yet returns a machine-pass label while inventory_exhaustive is false.
blocking_findings.counterevidence: The result explicitly preserves future/preopened-writer limitations and blocks canonical execution; supplied access-denied or extra bounded rows fail.
blocking_findings.adjudication: The nonclaim prevents authority escalation, but corrected-design partial-enumeration semantics are not implemented. This remains a hold even after the executable-identity fix.
blocking_findings.required_resolution: Require collector-signed enumeration completeness/coverage metadata, retain inaccessible bounded rows as blocking evidence rather than omission, and keep strict writer-race dissent unresolved.

v2_counterexample_adjudication.basis: Raw parent_id must equal frozen row and parent identity must equal frozen canonical parent.
Token, leaf, file identity, size, and hashes are jointly compared.
Derived sets now come from one supplied process array, but omission or incomplete enumeration remains possible.
Boot must follow frozen_at and be no later than capture start.
A supplied onedrive.exe row blocks, but omitted rows are not detectable by pure policy.
Parent file identity keys must be unique.
Current and parent process fields plus all supplied process rows are continuity-bound.
Pure bytes-only parsing and production provenance fields reject provider/test backend injection and retain the complete closed raw record.
Local projection is descriptive only and every result says human and capability verification are external and absent.

preserved_appeals.position: Because every result blocks canonical execution, machine-pass overbreadth is harmless.
preserved_appeals.response: It is materially safer than V2 and prevents present effects, but the reviewed task is component qualification against the corrected design. A knowingly overbroad machine-pass cannot be frozen into a future production component.

preserved_appeals.position: An independently trusted execution-freeze digest can replace static-allowlist validation.
preserved_appeals.response: A digest authenticates bytes, not the correctness of the initial projection. The exact static allowlist is a normative predecessor and must be deterministically bound.

preserved_appeals.position: The production collector will guarantee process completeness and executable identity outside pure policy.
preserved_appeals.response: That may close part of the gap only after the collector schema carries structured, frozen, independently checked evidence and the policy refuses missing or inconsistent fields.

preserved_strict_writer_race_dissent.reason: Even corrected process and handle checks do not exclude every preopened, future, renamed, hidden, kernel, sync, ancestor-thread, or noncooperating writer in replacement-compatible windows.

dad_learning_loop.preflight_search: No applicable DAD lesson nodes were returned; lesson graph was stale and candidate-only.
dad_learning_loop.candidate_exception: A synthetic policy fixture can pass while being structurally incompatible with the exact production allowlist. Future component reviews require an exact production-row projection test before fixture-only semantic PASS can qualify a component.

next_action: Keep the V3 policy component unfrozen. Repair exact static-allowlist binding and representability, implement a deterministically checked acyclic artifact DAG, bind stable executable file identities and hashes, enforce process coverage uncertainty and complete chronology, and add exact counterexample tests. Then freeze new hashes and obtain a fresh independent checker, premortem, and boss ruling. Canonical execution remains separately blocked by the absent external owner capability and strict writer-race dissent.
